Summary:
- Meridian RapidAI: programmatic adtech stack (real-time auction decisions). Tight SLOs: p95 end-to-end scoring latency target 40ms for cold requests, p95 20-30ms for warm/cache-hit scenarios. Cost-sensitive: want <= $200 per million scoring requests (ballpark).
- Workload profile: extremely high QPS during peaks (bursts up to 6k qps for short windows), typical sequence length 8-32 tokens, many repeated user contexts (good candidate for prefix/KV caching).
POC ask / success criteria:
- Show throughput curves and tail-latency at target QPS for three model variants (base LLaMA-2-ish 13B float16, quantized 4-bit 13B, distilled 6B) running on Dedicated pool.
- Demonstrate batching behavior: max batch sizes, latency vs batch tradeoffs, batching heuristics under bursty traffic.
- Validate prefix/KV caching benefits for repeat bidder contexts (measure hit-rate delta and token-cost reduction).
- Produce cost model: tokens-per-call, batching efficiency, VPU/GPU utilization, estimated monthly cost at 2M qps-hours.
- Security checklist: SSO + SAML integration required, KMS for keys, audit logging, minimal data residency constraints (US/NA).

- "We can give up some small percent on cost, but latency is non-negotiable — can't trade more than ~10% latency increase for 30-40% cost savings."
- "If caching reduces token spend by >20% while keeping p95 below 35ms, that's a win."

- Prefer Dedicated for predictable tail latency; want autoscale headroom for burst windows.
- Interested in 4-bit quantization and our quant-profiles; wants benchmarks showing quality delta vs unquantized.

- Request: include cold-start time, KV-cache warmup curve, and fallback behavior when dedicated pool saturated.
